# Automated_Assessment_Framework

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An optimization-based framework for automatically evaluating biological or network system outputs against predefined criteria. Enables scalable, objective validation of both TCC network behaviors and iNEST spiking responses, reducing manual analysis overhead.
